Name: non-expressive player sprite
Author: isari112
Description:
Did you even want to look like a total sociopath? Or maybe you're just a kuudere simp (like me) and want to look like a person that lacks any sign of emotions? Yeah, I basically edited farmer's sprite to make it less expressive, so it looks this way. I definitely didn't make it just to play as my OC that has difficulty with expressing emotions, completely---

Includes both female and male version, so have fun. Use however you want, just credit me and don't put it behind a paywall.
